div.head: CHn cor 1.1
div.ab: Et quia regnum oppressum erat iniustis exactionibus, ego, Dei respectu et amore quem erga vos [omnes] habeo, sanctam Dei aecclesiam inprimis liberam facio, ita quod nec vendam nec ad firmam ponam nec, mortuo archiepiscopo sive episcopo sive abbate, aliquid accipiam de dominio aecclesiae vel de hominibus eius donec successor in eam ingrediatur.

And because the realm had been harassed by unjust exactions, I, in veneration of God and for the love which I bear towards you all, in the first place establish the liberty of the holy church of God, in such wise that I shall not sell any of the demesne land of the church or let it or, on the death of an archbishop, bishop or abbot, take anything from it, or from the men belonging to it, until a successor enters upon office.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 276–277 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
